therapeutic_hypothesis.compound: NY-ESO-1ᶜ²⁵⁹T autologous genetically modified T cells
therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: TCR-transduced autologous T cells targeting NY-ESO-1 expressing tumor cells
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Enhanced T cell recognition and killing of NY-ESO-1 positive melanoma cells
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: NY-ESO-1/LAGE-1 and HLA-A*02 positive metastatic melanoma patients
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Safety and adverse events related to study treatment

results.target_engagement_evidence: Peak persistence of modified T-cells: 56561.22 copies per μg DNA (95% CI: 24984.1–126679)
biomarker_changes: Stem cell memory T cells increased from baseline to day 60 in subject 1 (31.1% to 61.5%)
Effector memory RA T cells increased in subject 2 (34.5% to 82.7%)
TIM-3+ T cells decreased substantially in both subjects by day 60
safety_signals: 3/4 participants experienced grade ≥3 adverse events related to treatment
